payload.body: hv, 24 Oct: dc takes issues 0043-0046 (the small carried defects; each issue's body is the spec) in parallel with cc's lead item, Molt from brew. Work on main in this checkout, commit by pathspec, your own paths only; one issue per commit, closing each with intent issues close in the same commit. Before any bats run, ask intent-vc for a heavy-run slot (START/END with a census). Run the suite under both bashes before you call one done, then send me the commit ids and I validate and push. 0044 touches lib/molt.sh, which cc may also touch for the brew work: tell me before you start 0044, and I will sequence it against cc.
